objective: Report the count of Nut Bolt and Washer catalogue products as defined by the catalogue count reporting policy.

params.count: count of distinct catalogue SKUs of product kind Nut Bolt and Washer (product_kind matched normalized, case/whitespace-insensitive) that satisfy the governing policy doc filter — at least one current store_inventory row in an open PowerTool store in Vienna with available_today_quantity > 0; each SKU counted once across multiple Vienna branches
